description: Check whether the planned labor fits the workers' calendars over whole days in the account's time zone: feasible, unknown (a calendar or plan is missing) or overloaded, with the planned person-hours and each slice that is short of crew and the operations in it. from is YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to today); days is 1–30 (default 7). includeAuthorizedOvertime counts overtime windows as available. Labor alone never validates a delivery date. Admin; operator credentials only.

from.description: The first day, YYYY-MM-DD in the account's time zone; defaults to today.

includeAuthorizedOvertime.description: Count authorized overtime windows as available.
